messages:
Nina R.: GreenLeaf POC blocked — they get 401 + \"scope_mismatch\" calling /v1/generate. They say key worked during onboarding.
Omar (ae): ask for curl and the raw response body & headers (redact key). Common cause: key has wrong scopes or was created in a different org/project.
Customer: curl shown: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-GL-OLD\" -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-small\",\"input\":\"ping\"}'`
Theo (engineer): have them hit `GET /v1/keys/inspect` with the same Authorization header to see `owner_org`, `owner_project`, `scopes`.
Customer: inspect -> `owner_org: greenleaf-sandbox`, `owner_project: onboarding`, `scopes: [\"embeddings:read\"]`
Nina R.: that explains it — they need `inference:invoke` (or `chat:invoke` for chat endpoints).
Theo (engineer): minimal repro after creating a scoped key:
```bash
curl -i -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer sk-poc-GREEN\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-small\",\"input\":\"hello\"}'
```
SupportBot: include the `request-id` from the error response and any `x-rw-` headers so infra can trace.
Customer: rotated and created key under the correct POC project with `inference:invoke`. Got `401` again, response `{\"error\":\"unauthorized\",\"request_id\":\"rq_7f4e1b\"}` and header `x-rw-quota: 0/10000`
Theo (engineer): pulling trace for rq_7f4e1b. SupportBot: start trace.
SupportBot: trace shows key used was bound to a different org at moment of request (race during rotation). We see a short delay propagating binding across auth cache.
Omar (ae): recommended immediate mitigation: create new key, wait 30s, retry. For POC, create short-lived key, set spend cap on project, and IP allowlist if needed.
Nina R.: customer asks about billing: will rotating or creating a new key cause charges?
Theo (engineer): charges follow the project that makes the API calls. Creating keys does not bill. Set project spend cap if worried.
Customer: retried after 1m and got 200 + tokens. Thanks — please leave tip in onboarding about waiting 30s after key creation.
Nina R.: will update POC checklist: inspect key binding, ensure `inference:invoke` scope, create key on correct project, wait ~30s for propagation, set expiry/spend cap, include `request-id` for traces. Closing thread. :white_check_mark:
